title: Totem Teleport
description: This adds a totem of undying that lets you teleport to any coordinates once the totem pops.
body:
The project adds a totem like the totem that jamatop used in the unstable smp. Once the totem pops you get teleported to the coordinates you set after using the command.

### Usage
- /totem <x> <y> <z>

### Instructions
1. Download the .jar file look at what loader its made for.
2. Then make a server with that loader and its version and put the .jar file.
3. If its fabric in the .mods folder if its papermc in the .plugins folder.
